en: blowing — air directed from the mouth into the bānsurī

occurrences.snippet: That bamboo in which, by varying the blowing, five notes arise in order, Sa, Sa, Pa, Sa, Ga, is the one approved by the śāstra of the bānsurī.

occurrences.subsection_title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
occurrences.snippet: The issuing of air from the mouth is called phūtkāra (blowing). It is prākṛta (natural) and vaikṛta (cultivated), and the third is kṛtrima (artificial).

occurrences.subsection_title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
occurrences.snippet: That is, the directed issue, that is, the flow, of air from the mouth is called phūtkāra, that is, phūṅk (blowing). It has three kinds: prākṛta (natural), vaikṛta (cultivated) and …
